title: "Manage platform notifications"

View <!-- and customize --> the notifications sent by the {{< var validmind.platform >}} to your organization's users. Notifications are sent both to user emails and to the in-{{< var vm.platform >}} inbox.

:::{.callout}
Changes are automatically saved to your account and do not affect other users.
:::

::: {.attn}

## Prerequisites

- [x] {{< var link.login >}}

:::

## View platform notifications

::: {.callout}
Unread {{< fa bell >}} Updates will be marked with a [pink {{< fa circle >}}]{.pink}.
:::

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa inbox >}} My Inbox**.

2. Select the **Updates** tab.

    Each update is a self-contained row: a type icon, a bold title, when it happened, a context line with the record or workflow it belongs to, and any actions one step below. Updates about you read as "You were …"; updates about others name them. Click an update to open what it refers to, which also marks it as read.

3. From the in-{{< var vm.platform >}} inbox, review updates, accept invites, mark updates as read, or dismiss updates entirely:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Review updates

To filter updates:

a. Click **{{< fa filter >}} Filter** to narrow down the kinds of updates displayed:

    - Under **Update type**, select one of the in-{{< var vm.platform >}} notification types, or **All types**.[^1]
    - Under **Show**, select **Unread only** to display only unread updates, or **Dismissed only** to display only dismissed updates.

b. Active filters are shown as chips above the list. Click **{{< fa xmark >}}** on a chip to remove that filter, or **Clear all** to remove them all.

To show older updates, scroll down to the bottom and click **Load more**. Faint shading at the top or bottom of the list means more updates sit above or below the fold.


<!-- ### Accept invites

Invites to join a {{< var vm.product >}} organization offer the option to accept the invite from within the {{< var vm.platform >}}:

- Click **Accept Invite** to join the organization.
- Accepting an invite will automatically mark the invitation notification as read. -->

### Mark updates as read

Opening an update marks it as read. To mark an individual update as read or unread without opening it:

a. On the update's row, click the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu.

b. Select **Mark as read** or **Mark as unread**.

To mark multiple updates as read:

a. Hover over the type icon of an update until it becomes a checkbox, then select it. Select the checkboxes for the other updates you want to include, or click **Select all loaded updates**.

b. On the selection bar that appears at the bottom of the list, confirm the number of updates selected, then select **Mark as read**.

To mark every update as read at once, click the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu at the top of the list and select **Mark all as read**.

### Dismiss updates

To dismiss an individual update:

a. On the update's row, click the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu.

b. Select **Dismiss**. The confirmation offers **Undo** for a moment afterwards.

To dismiss multiple updates:

a. Hover over the type icon of an update until it becomes a checkbox, then select it. Select the checkboxes for the other updates you want to include, or click **Select all loaded updates**.

b. On the selection bar that appears at the bottom of the list, confirm the number of updates selected, then select **Dismiss**.

Dismissed updates remain available under the **Dismissed only** filter, where **Restore** on the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu returns one to your inbox. Live critical announcements cannot be dismissed and are skipped when you dismiss a selection.[^announcements]

:::

#### Available update filters

Mentions
: Comments you're mentioned in.[^2]

Record Invites
: Stakeholders added to your records.[^3]

Record Stage Updates
: Record stage transitions on your records.[^4]

Announcements
: Organization-wide notices published by your Customer Admins.[^announcements] Each shows its level, an excerpt, and how long it stays live; click it to read the full message. Critical announcements are pinned to the top and cannot be dismissed while they are live.

## Add My Inbox to your dashboard

You can also add **My Inbox** to a dashboard as a widget, under **Add Widget** > **Other**.[^my-inbox-widget] The widget opens on the **Updates** tab and offers the same **Tasks** and **Updates** tabs and per-item actions as the sidebar inbox. Filters and multi-selection stay in the sidebar inbox. Acting on an item in either place updates the other.

## Document jobs in your inbox {#document-jobs}

**{{< fa inbox >}} My Inbox** also shows long-running document jobs while they are in progress: reading an uploaded PDF so it can be checked, and the {{< var vm.checker >}} run itself.^[[Check documents for compliance](/guide/documentation/check-documents-for-compliance.qmd)]

Each job shows live progress and can be stopped from its row. A job appears wherever you are signed in — after a reload, in a second tab, and for a job someone else started on a document you can see.

These rows behave differently from the updates above:

- They are not one of the update types, so the filters above do not apply to them.
- They are not marked as read.
- Dismissing a finished job hides its row **in the browser you dismissed it in**, rather than for your account everywhere. A finished job stops appearing on its own after a day.

## Customize email notifications

::: {.callout}
To customize which platform notifications are sent to users in your organization, you must be a [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble}.[^5]
:::

Enable or disable email notifications for specific events across your organization:

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa gear >}} Settings**.

2. Under {{< fa building >}} Organization, select **Email Notifications**.

3. Toggle the options for each event on or off according to your requirements.

   **Critical announcements** controls whether every member is emailed when a Customer Admin publishes a critical announcement.[^announcements]

4. Click **Save Changes** to apply your adjustments.
